fullDescription: A focused, ADHD-friendly task management UI featuring soft glassmorphism, a calming teal color palette, and high-legibility typography. The design emphasizes a single primary call-to-action to reduce cognitive load, utilizing large touch targets and generous whitespace. Suitable for wellness apps, meditation platforms, productivity tools, and neuro-inclusive software designs. Key features include a glassmorphic hero gradient, bold 'Lexend' headers, and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for supportive UI elements.

structured.summary: A minimalist, high-contrast task detail screen designed for focus and low cognitive friction. It features a top-down glassmorphic teal gradient, centered high-radius cards, and a massive primary action button with a vibrant gradient to drive user completion without overwhelming the interface.

style.description: The style utilizes a 'Soft Wellness' aesthetic. Typography pairings: 'Lexend' for bold, rounded headings that feel approachable; 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body and metadata for high readability. Colors: Primary Teal (#006b5f), secondary bright teal (#14b8a6), and a neutral warm surface (#f9f9f8). Shadows are extremely subtle (0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03)) to maintain a light, airy feel.
style.prompt: Create a design system using a soft-minimalist aesthetic. Palette: Primary Teal (#006b5f), Gradient Teal (linear-gradient(135deg, #006b5f 0%, #14b8a6 100%)), Background Surface (#f9f9f8), Secondary Surface (#f3f4f3), and Deep Slate Text (#1a1c1c). Typography: Titles in 'Lexend' (weights 600, 700), Body/UI in 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (weights 400, 500, 600). Components must feature high corner radii (32px for cards, 9999px for pills/buttons). Shadows: light card-shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.03)). Animation: Hover states should use a subtle scale-up (1.05x) and active states a scale-down (0.97x) with a 0.2s ease transition.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertically stacked, centered layout optimized for mobile and desktop focus. The top section uses a background gradient to create depth, while the main content area focuses on a single task at a time.

prompts.partPt: Menu do Topo and Glass Topo Principal (Hero)
prompts.prompt: Top-aligned header with a back button (48x48px white circle, centered icon) on the left. Background features a 'glass-hero' gradient starting from 8% opacity Teal (#006b5f) at the top, fading to transparent at 384px height. Use a 'more' options button (ghost style) on the right.

Central focus area. Top element is a 96x96px white card with 40px radius containing a large emoji (64px). Below, an uppercase label in 11px font with 0.15em tracking. The main task title is 32px-36px Lexend Bold, centered, with tight tracking.

A horizontal row of badges below the title. Each badge is a pill shape (9999px radius), 12px font, semibold, with 1.5rem horizontal padding. Use a light teal background for high priority/ritual tasks and a neutral gray for status.

A centered, wide card (max-width 384px) with 32px border radius. White background, 1px slate-100 border. Left side features a 48px square icon container with 16px radius. Display 'Estimated Time' in 12px muted text above the actual duration in 18px Bold Lexend. Right side features a muted chevron icon.

A dedicated section for the primary task action. Features a large inactive timer display (72px, mono-spaced font, light gray). The primary CTA is a 64px height pill-shaped button with a teal gradient and white text, featuring a play icon. Below the CTA, include a 'forgiveness' link: small, muted text for skipping the task to reduce user guilt.

special_ui_components.description: High-visibility action button designed for tactile satisfaction.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a pill-shaped button, height 64px, width 100%. Background: linear-gradient(135deg, #006b5f 0%, #14b8a6 100%). Box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 107, 95, 0.1). Text: 18px Lexend Bold, white. Micro-interaction: On click, scale to 0.97 and slightly dim opacity to 0.9.

special_ui_components.description: Background element providing depth without distracting the user.
special_ui_components.prompt: An absolute-positioned div at the top of the viewport. Height 384px. Background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0, 107, 95, 0.08), transparent). Z-index: -10. Ensures content is readable while providing a localized brand color wash.

structured.special_notes: Must maintain a high degree of whitespace to prevent sensory overload. The 'Skip' link must never feel like a 'failure' button—it should be styled as a low-emphasis utility link. The primary action button must be the most visually heavy element on the page. Use a mono-spaced font only for the timer to prevent layout shifts as numbers change.
